column_sum.name: Column reduction
column_sum.contract: run(x) returns the sum over dimension zero of contiguous 2D CUDA x. Reference x.float().sum(dim=0).to(x.dtype). Output newly allocated contiguous shape (width,), same device and float32/bfloat16 dtype. Input immutable. Rows 1..256, width 1..4096 including odd sizes. Accumulate FP32, cast once. Each output element reduces rows, not columns.

l2_normalize.name: Row L2 normalization
l2_normalize.contract: run(x) returns fp*rsqrt(sum(fp*fp,dim=-1,keepdim=True)+1e-6), cast once to input dtype, where fp=x.float(). This is L2 normalization using SUM, not mean. Input contiguous 2D CUDA float32/bfloat16, immutable. Output newly allocated contiguous same shape/device/dtype. Rows 1..256, width 1..4096 including odd sizes. All arithmetic FP32.

affine_silu.name: Affine SiLU
affine_silu.contract: run(x,weight,bias), x contiguous 2D CUDA (rows,width), weight and bias contiguous vectors (width,), same float32/bfloat16 dtype. Compute z=x.float()*weight.float()+bias.float(); result=(z/(1+exp(-z))).to(x.dtype). This is z*sigmoid(z), not sigmoid(z). Fresh contiguous output same shape/device/dtype; inputs immutable. Rows 1..256, width 1..4096 including odd sizes. All arithmetic FP32, single final cast.

scale_transpose.name: Column scaling and transpose
scale_transpose.contract: run(x,weight), contiguous CUDA 2D x of shape (rows,width) and vector weight (width,), same float32/bfloat16 dtype. Compute (x.float()*weight.float()).T.to(x.dtype).contiguous() using Triton. Output newly allocated contiguous (width,rows), same device/dtype. All inputs immutable. Rows 1..256, width 1..1024, including non-square and odd sizes. Multiply FP32 then cast once; a view is not accepted.
